skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Guides creation of polished, distinctive frontend interfaces with strong visual direction.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces reduce trust and make products harder to remember. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished, context-specific frontend designs.
actual_capabilities: Guides selection of a clear visual direction before implementation.
Supports frontend work for components, pages, applications, and interfaces.
Encourages production-grade HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue output.
Provides guidance for typography, color, motion, layout, and backgrounds.
Discourages generic AI design patterns and repeated visual choices.
Matches implementation complexity to the chosen aesthetic concept.
limitations: Does not include executable tools, scripts, or design assets.
Requires clear product goals and technical constraints from the user.
Does not replace accessibility testing, browser testing, or design review.
May need adaptation to existing design systems and brand rules.

use_cases.title: Create A Product Page
use_cases.description: Design and implement a memorable product page with strong typography, layout, and motion.

use_cases.title: Refresh An App Screen
use_cases.description: Turn a plain dashboard or workflow screen into a polished interface with a clear visual point of view.

use_cases.title: Prototype A Web Component
use_cases.description: Build a refined interactive component that uses intentional color, spacing, and visual details.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Page Build
prompt_templates.scenario: Start from a simple page request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to build a landing page for a small finance app. Make it distinctive, responsive, and production-ready.

prompt_templates.title: Component With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to create a pricing card component in React. Keep it accessible, compact, and visually memorable.

prompt_templates.title: Design Direction Exploration
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask for a clear visual concept before coding.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to propose one bold aesthetic direction, then implement a dashboard screen that follows it consistently.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Product Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use frontend-design to build a multi-section SaaS onboarding flow with strong hierarchy, refined motion, and responsive behavior.

output_examples.input: Build a homepage for an editorial newsletter.
output_examples.output: A responsive editorial layout with distinctive typography, strong spacing, custom visual texture, and focused subscription actions.
A polished dashboard with clearer hierarchy, purposeful density, refined colors, and subtle motion for important state changes.
A working product card with expressive layout, contextual visual details, hover states, and production-ready structure.

best_practices: Provide the product context, audience, framework, and accessibility requirements before asking for implementation.
Ask for one clear aesthetic direction, then require the code to follow it consistently.
Review the result in real viewports and adjust spacing, contrast, and motion.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic modern interface without context or constraints.
Do not accept decorative effects that weaken usability or performance.
Do not skip accessibility, responsive behavior, or production readiness checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive frontend components, pages, applications, and interface designs.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written guidance and does not include scripts or tool automation.

faq.question: Can it work with React or Vue?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill mentions HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend outputs.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide components, pages, applications, and full interface workflows.

faq.question: What should I include in my prompt?
faq.answer: Include the interface goal, audience, technical stack, constraints, and any brand or accessibility requirements.
